gri_path: GRI 1: 8519 sound reproducing apparatus; GRI 6: 8519.81 using semiconductor media, sound reproducing only, other

rejected_alternatives.reason: sound recording and reproducing; this item only reproduces
loudspeaker alone; device is complete player

missing_facts: storage media type; whether it records
classification.rationale: A battery-operated device that only plays back stored calls is sound reproducing apparatus using semiconductor media. N334310 (a recording and reproducing device) is a related precedent but covers recording.
